set.body:
Source: 2026-07-25 review finding 8.

Problem:
FileJournalControlStore.append (managed/FileJournalControlStore.scala:128-130) does JournalCodec.encode(...).fold(problem => throw JournalException(problem), identity). transact already returns F[Either[ControlFailure, ControlCommit]] and ControlFailure.JournalCorrupt exists, so a command whose canonical JSON exceeds maximumRecordBytes (32 MiB default) raises instead of returning Left.

That is a routine, deterministic, caller-fixable outcome escalated to an effect failure, which is the rule ADR 0001 states most emphatically.

Acceptance:
- Record-encoding failure (including size overflow) is returned as Left(ControlFailure), not raised.
- Genuine IO failure of the durable write may still raise, and the journal is still truncated back to the pre-append offset.
- Truncation failure during rollback does not mask the original error.
- A test transacts an oversized command and asserts a typed Left with the journal unchanged.
set.title: P6f.35: Return journal record-encoding failure as ControlFailure
